bullets.text: Data Structures and Algorithms, Operating Systems, Database Systems, Computer Networks
Improved CI reliability by maintaining a GitHub Actions Playwright dispatch runner, and helped enforce code and product standards through code reviews and exploratory testing
Extended automated testing to the GraphQL API layer by designing and implementing GraphQL-specific test suites
Architected a fault-tolerant, scalable Go microservice backend for a multi-tenant mobile CRM deployed on EC2
Built an asynchronous and scalable ingestion pipeline with a Redis job queue to handle contact data processing, enabling non-blocking operations and configurable business rules per tenant
Designed a PostgreSQL schema for full contact lifecycle tracking across multiple organizations, shipping via a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline with automated testing

Designed and built a full-stack scalable multilingual translation management system from scratch using ReactJS, API integrations, prompt engineering, and database design, enabling company employees to create, preview, and approve over 500 contents across several languages and dialects cost-effectively

Built and automated stale link detection across multiple wellness apps in Ruby on Rails, implementing parallelized link testing, rerouting handling, and daily scheduled jobs, integrated into Octopus Deploy workflow with structured logging for operational visibility
Built a React browser extension that scrapes job descriptions from any job board, letting users review, tailor, and export a polished resume in one workflow

Cut resume-tailoring time by 90% (30 min → 3 min) with a FastAPI pipeline combining pgvector/Supabase-based semantic search, keyword matching, knapsack-based content selection, and an iterative Claude-powered refinement loop

Developed a recipe recommendation system using Python, Firebase, and Edamam API, and added ingredient classification with NER (spaCy), enabling structured pantry organization, dietary analysis, and personalized recipe retrieval

Created and optimized REST APIs using Python, FastAPI and BaseModel to manage complex JSON data from various APIs, enhancing backend functionality and ensuring seamless communication with multiple databases
Designed and organized educational curriculum and workshops
Recruited and interviewed new members, placing them into suitable projects to maximize contribution and learning
